chunks: Yūnus narrated from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, who said:

I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: Two women sleep in a single garment? He said: “They are to be beaten.” He said: I said: As a hadd punishment? He said: “No.” I said: Two men sleep in a single garment? He said: “They are to be beaten.” He said: I said: The hadd? He said: “No.”

key_terms.الْحَدَّ: the hadd punishment in the legal sense
key_terms.يُضْرَبَانِ: they are to be beaten as discipline

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on two men or two women sleeping in one garment according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام concerning two women or two men sleeping in one garment. The Imam states that they are to be beaten as a disciplinary measure, while explicitly denying that this is a hadd punishment.
